subject: Request to shift Redwood demo away from re:Invent week
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@finco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 29 @ 10am PT

Hi Alice,

Following up from the call last week — I put a tentative 60-minute demo on Nov 29 at 10:00am PT to walk through the Redwood Inference hosted flows and dedicated capacity options for FinCo. Attendees I have down: you, an SRE lead, and two product folks.

Agenda (attached):
- 10m intros & goals
- 25m live demo (routing, cost controls, observability)
- 15m Q&A + next steps

If that time doesn't work, please let me know alternate windows; we can also split into a short technical session + follow-up deep dive. Attached the draft agenda.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@finco.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinCo Eng Team <eng-admin@finco.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 29 @ 10am PT

Hi Vanessa — thanks for scheduling. Small snag: Nov 29 falls in the heart of our re:Invent travel window — most of the engineering and product leads will be on-site or traveling that week. We also have a company-wide freeze Nov 30–Dec 2 for end-of-quarter ops.

Would you be able to move the demo to either:
- the week of Nov 16–20 (earlier), or
- the week of Dec 6–10 (after our freeze), ideally Dec 8–10 in the afternoons PT?

If neither works, a recorded demo + a 30-minute live Q&A with our SREs on Dec 9 would also work. Attendees: me (Alice), Omar (SRE), Priya (Product).

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Director of Product Integrations | FinCo
alice.jenkins@finco.com

Subject: Fwd: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 29 @ 10am PT

Marcus / Aisha — forwarding FinCo's note. Nov 29 is during their travel week; they want earlier Nov 16–20 or Dec 6–10 (prefer Dec 8–10 afternoons PT). Also acceptable: record + 30m live Q&A on Dec 9.

We have two constraints on our side: several of us will be at re:Invent the week of Nov 27 and the company has an internal conference blackout policy (see attached). I can run a pre-recorded demo if Aisha can take the live Q&A on Dec 9 (she's the best fit on the tech side). If we want a full live demo with product + SE both present, Dec 8–10 works for me.

Which option should I propose?
- Offer Dec 8 @ 1pm PT for full live demo (everyone available)
- Offer pre-record + Dec 9 @ 11am PT live Q&A with Aisha

Thoughts?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachment: redwood-conference-blackout-notice.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 29 @ 10am PT

Agree with the approach. Aisha — can you take the Q&A on Dec 9 at 11am PT if Vanessa records the demo? If you prefer a full live walkthrough, we should lock Dec 8 @ 1pm PT (I can cover product context remotely). Either is fine, but let's prioritize the customer availability (Dec 8–10).

Vanessa — if you send both options to Alice (Dec 8 @ 1pm PT OR recorded + Dec 9 @ 11am PT live Q&A) I'll push it through and update the HubSpot deal. Also include the Zoom link and the HubSpot meeting record.

Marcus
Manager, West Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 29 @ 10am PT

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick reply and the windows. We can do one of the following:

Option A — Full live demo (recommended): Tue, Dec 8 @ 1:00pm PT / 4:00pm ET (60 min)
- Vanessa (AE) + Marcus (cover product context remotely) + Aisha (SE) will join.

Option B — Recorded demo + live Q&A: Recorded demo shared ahead of time + Wed, Dec 9 @ 11:00am PT (30 min) for live Q&A with Aisha.

Which do you prefer? I've created tentative calendar invites for both (attached updated-invite.ics). Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210. I'll also add the HubSpot meeting record: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/FIN-2026-087.

If you confirm Option A, I'll send a final invite and copy in your SREs. If Option B, I'll share the recording by Dec 7 and confirm the Q&A slot.

Appreciate it — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
